coordinates: Coordinates are pixels from the upper-left of the full USB image after rotation to its upright orientation. Subtract the archived crop origin in setup.json to locate a coordinate in a lossless frame.

physical_anchors.basis: Derek set the starting meniscus to the one-cup mark.
Derek confirmed the amount in the cup stayed constant while moving the camera. The front quarter- and thirds-cup graduations bracket the new near-wall reading.

steep_view.why_physical_anchors_matter: The far-wall contact moves relative to the printed scale as the sight line through the glass changes with depth. The one-cup start and the same-fill side reading establish the physical span.
steep_view.edge: The steep view uses the exposed far arc, a white-glass to dark-liquid edge in the upper frames and the onset of amber color against the sink lower down. Visible print registers each frame to the rested frame.
steep_view.printed_coordinate: For each sight line, subtract the start contact offset from the registered height. Evaluate the monotone piecewise cubic through the accepted printed graduations. Extend the lowest printed interval linearly when needed.
steep_view.physical_fraction: For printed-coordinate readings p, the fraction withdrawn is (p_start - p_endpoint) / (p_start - p_rest).
steep_view.physical_volume: Cup volume equals start_ml minus that fraction times (start_ml - rested_side_ml). Endpoints use the median of the available fitted traces. Trial withdrawals use the median of paired differences from the same traces.

side_view.rerouted_volume_method: The near-wall contact is read on both upright scales after the tubing swap. Successive volumes use the median of six printed positions. Each frame registers to its own print.

uncertainty.reading: The reported allowances cover interpretation of the meniscus, disagreement between the front scales, sensitivity to the fitted curve and any extrapolation. Kitchen-cup calibration and the hand-set starting level also contribute unmeasured systematic error.
uncertainty.shared_anchors: Every steep-view withdrawal shares the starting and ending anchors. A change in their volume span scales all steep-view rates together. The liquid level in a shared frame also enters adjacent withdrawals with opposite signs.
uncertainty.model_sensitivity: The minimum and maximum withdrawal columns compare the five traced positions, linear interpolation of registered height and an offset in printed volume. These model ranges describe variation among correlated readings. The practical reading allowances include additional uncertainty.
uncertainty.direct_side: The successive side-view withdrawals use the same readable positions. The sharper outer pair also supplies an independent combined volume. A blurred intermediate and below-mark extrapolation limit the separate probes.
uncertainty.rerouted: The two printed columns bound the direct reading. The lower swapped-start level requires extrapolation. A red stroke can cover a middle-fill contact, which is fitted through neighboring clear glass. The camera reading and scale load share an empirical comparison in the side traces.

rate_basis.motor_on: Cup withdrawal divided by summed elapsed time reported for completed motor commands. Dry-start cup withdrawal includes line filling.
rate_basis.per_pulse: Cup withdrawal across a pulse train divided by its completed pulse count.
rate_basis.scheduled_cycle: Cup withdrawal across a pulse train divided by its completed pulse count times the scheduled start-to-start period. This includes the final periodic pause.
rate_basis.direction: Cup withdrawal is signed positive out of the measuring cup and negative into it. Transfer and motor-on rates give the magnitude. The direction column identifies the source vessel.
